reveals.name: Carapace Scavenger
reveals.description: A cursed soldier of the fallen legion

reveals.name: Stone Saint
reveals.description: Deep in the cavernous halls of his dark domain, the last child of the -unknown- had created them from stone to quell the fire burning in his resentful heart. However, that fire only grew hotter. Designed to bring peace, they were instead born into an endless war.

attributes.name: Battle Master
attributes.description: Born on the battlefield, the Stone Saint is proficient in all forms of combat.

attributes.name: Stalwart
attributes.description: The Stone Saint is highly resistant to all forms of damage, as well as being fully immune to mind and soul attacks.

reveals.name: Shadow Blade Kurt
reveals.description: I have entrusted you with a beautiful blade, but all you created was a hideous nightmare.

attributes.name: Swift Hand
attributes.description: Your blade strikes fast and true.

attributes.name: Mark of Death
attributes.description: You bear a mark of Death, as just like Death, you were created to be a weapon.

abilities.name: Shadow Manipulation
abilities.description: You can affect the movement of shadows and walk through them unseen.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.description: You can strike at the shadows, and your shadow can strike at the living things.

abilities.name: Awakened
abilities.description: This Echo has the innate abilities of a carrier of the Spell.
